correct.description: Bar/dumbbells start racked at shoulder height, press to full overhead lockout without excessive lower-back arch

common_errors.description: Arms do not reach full extension overhead -- incomplete lockout
One arm presses higher or faster than the other
Lower back arches excessively to help drive the press overhead -- a spinal-safety concern
common_errors.status_note: Lumbar hyperextension during an overhead press is a well-established injury-risk pattern, but the precise geometric threshold is uncertain from position-only landmarks (shoulder/hip/knee angle is a PROXY for spinal extension, not a direct spine-curvature measurement) -- and this is exactly the kind of safety-relevant threshold the build task requires PT confirmation for rather than an invented number. No threshold value is seeded (see thresholds block: null) pending that confirmation.

keypoint_signature.rule: PROXY ONLY, not PT-confirmed: angle(shoulder, hip, knee) deviates from a neutral-spine reference by more than threshold.ohp_lumbar_hyperextension_tolerance -- do not implement against this rule without PT sign-off on the actual geometric definition of 'excessive' for this population.

thresholds._status: SEED values only -- placeholders pending real field-measured tuning per EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §4. Not authoritative; do not treat as validated. ohp_lumbar_hyperextension_tolerance is intentionally null -- see the lumbar_hyperextension fault's status_note; this build task's hard rule is to mark it for PT confirmation rather than invent a safety threshold.

rep_counting._note: "top" = full overhead lockout (rest/reference between reps, highest elbow angle), "bottom" = racked at the shoulder (peak flexion) -- same top=rest/bottom=effort convention as pushup.json (press movements mirror push-up's polarity: extended=top, flexed=bottom).

coaching_cues.setup: Bar racked at shoulders, feet shoulder-width, core braced
coaching_cues.execution: Press straight overhead, keep your ribs down
coaching_cues.set_complete_no_flags: Strong set. Clean lockout every rep.
coaching_cues.set_complete_with_flags: Good set. Next time, watch your {flag_body_part} — {flag_cue}.

flag_cues.lockout_rom: Press all the way to full lockout
flag_cues.lumbar_hyperextension: Keep your ribs down, brace your core

shoulder_injury.modification: Reduce range of motion or switch to a landmine press. Stop if you feel shoulder pain.

back_injury.modification: Brace your core hard and avoid arching. Consider a seated press with back support.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding (Valsalva). Breathe out as you press up.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only (ADR-100/102). Cannot override rep count or safety flags -- and per this contract's hard rule, cannot substitute for PT confirmation on the lumbar_hyperextension fault's threshold either. Default off until expert-agreement eval passes.
